title: Pathway-specific microplastic dynamics in a Himalayan urban lake, India: insights on how continuous rainfall transforms microplastic characteristics and risk
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1848-1864
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00201J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mozim Shafi, Ayan Lodh, Reyaz Hussain Akhoon, Khalid Muzamil Gani, Sudha Goel
Microplastic (MP) pollution in freshwater systems has emerged as a pressing environmental concern, yet our efforts on prioritizing key pathways remain obscure. WWTP effluents and stormwater runoff were prioritized as high-risk pathways while laundry and littering as low-risk.
